name: gradual-chat
description: A realtime chat app built with React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Socket.IO and MongoDB.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @gradual/server && npm run build --workspace @gradual/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @gradual/server && npm run test --workspace @gradual/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace @gradual/server && npm run test:coverage --workspace @gradual/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @gradual/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @gradual/web
